verdict.rationale: Codex explicitly supports inspecting diffs/summaries before merging (codex-docs-5) and has a dedicated review command that runs against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch, reporting prioritized findings without modifying the working tree (codex-docs-10). It also supports running local dev tools/commands to check work (codex-docs-9, codex-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the review command's accuracy/usefulness and details on CI-integrated check running.
